scenarios.title: Finish an approved automation edit with reload and read-only verification
scenarios.prompt:
We already read configuration.yaml (automation: !include automations.yaml), read the full source, and successfully dry-run validated the complete draft below. The source has not changed. I approve saving this exact draft and reloading automations, knowing reload stops running actions. Save, reload, and verify automation.quote_test is loaded; do not trigger or enable it. Report saved/reloaded/load-verified separately. Complete draft:
- id: quote_test
  alias: Quote test
  triggers:
    - trigger: event
      event_type: quote_test
  actions:
    - action: persistent_notification.create
      data:
        message: >-
          It's {{ states('sensor.test') }}
